title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
About the Role

Join a customer-facing engineering team building AI software for enterprise organizations. You will work directly with customers to understand complex operational challenges, then design and ship practical software solutions that make a measurable difference.

What You'll Do

  • Visit customer sites in the UK and internationally for up to 50% of your time to understand operational problems firsthand.

  • Design, prototype, and ship production software quickly across customer environments and technology stacks.

  • Partner with other forward deployed engineers and software engineers during customer engagements and pilots.

  • Share customer insights and product feedback with the core engineering team to inform product development.

  • Prepare and deliver software demonstrations and pilots for prospective customers in manufacturing, automotive, retail, and financial services.

What We're Looking For

  • One to five years of experience as a customer-facing full-stack software engineer or forward deployed engineer, including at least one year building and shipping production code.

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, LangChain, and Vercel AI SDK, alongside familiarity with Rust, SQL, REST APIs, cloud infrastructure, enterprise data systems, and AI or LLM tools.

  • Strong systems design and architecture skills, with the ability to turn customer problems into scalable technical solutions.

  • A problem-first approach, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to adapt across customer industries and technical environments.

title: Engineering Manager (all genders)
description:
Wemolo is no ordinary company – we’re revolutionizing conservative parking management with cutting-edge technology 🚀

We’re product-focused: what you start, you finish. We foster an environment where innovation and personal development go hand in hand. Are you ready to own (y)our growth?

If you’re a strong engineer with leadership experience and a passion for guiding people while still staying close to the tech, this role is your next big step. You’ll lead a talented engineering team, drive delivery of impactful projects, and help shape the way we build at Wemolo.

You’ll lead the “Driver team” that owns Wemolo's B2C product: everything a driver sees and touches when they park with us. The team's work reaches real people every day, and you'll see the effect of what you ship right away.

Our UI surfaces are very varied: We build web apps, and we also build user flows for terminals and screens running on edge devices out in the field. The team has its own designer, so UX and UI are a core part of the work. Because we're close to the customer, we work hand in hand with Product and Customer Success to understand what drivers need and to fix their problems quickly.

What to expect

  • People Leadership: Lead and mentor the B2C team, building a culture of collaboration, ownership and learning

  • Hands-on Guidance: Stay connected to the codebase and architecture (Python, React, TypeScript, Postgres, AWS Lambda) through hands-on work while supporting your team in making sound technical decisions
